# DSH飞书Session控制

Repository: https://github.com/jason-namehard/dsh-feishu-session-control
Maintainer: 见川
License: AGPL-3.0
Verified target: DeepSeek Harness 0.1.2-rc.1, checked 2026-09-09

This project is a fork of PlutoKeating/dsh-lark-bot. It keeps upstream copyright and AGPL obligations while adding
in-process DSH compatibility, cross-workspace session aliases, recycle-bin/permanent deletion, an integrated Web
session manager, and half/full Feishu session attachment.

Key behavior:
- Web-created sessions are detached from Feishu by default.
- The first ordinary Feishu message creates and attaches a dedicated session in half mode.
- /use switches sessions without replaying history and resets to half mode.
- /switch selects half or full attachment.
- /detach removes only the Feishu attachment and keeps the DSH session.
- Half mode returns only Feishu-origin turns; full mode also mirrors later Web/TUI turns in that session.
- The plugin adds no per-tool approval gate; it mirrors only native DSH approvals, answerable in Web or Feishu.
- Stopping DSH stops Feishu. There is no Guardian, safemode takeover, automatic start, or automatic restart.

Install from source:
1. git clone https://github.com/jason-namehard/dsh-feishu-session-control.git
2. pnpm install && pnpm build
3. node bin/dsh-lark-bot.mjs setup --profile dsh-lark --package file:/absolute/path/to/dsh-feishu-session-control
4. dsh --profile web

Do not use npx dsh-lark-bot@latest for this fork; that npm name resolves to the upstream project.

Main commands:
/sessions, /new, /use, /switch, /detach, /rename, /delete, /purge, /mention, /status, /stop, /doctor, /upgrade
